external_collaboration.partner_name: YUFE (Young Universities for the Future of Europe)
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The UM can start as a degree awarding partner in the new unique bachelor programme Urban Sustainability Studies offered by YUFE (Young Universities for the Future of Europe), an alliance of ten European universities. This week, the UM received a positive outcome of the macro due diligence assessment.
